blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–A video of NLEX guard Enoch Valdez figuring in a fight with a player from the visiting Changwon LG Sakers of the Korean Basketball League has gone viral. Valdez was seen in the clip, which appeared to come from a South Korean television station and was later posted online, getting into a heated exchange with Sakers import and former NBA player Archie Goodwin. The incident appeared to be on the verge of turning into a larger fracas before cooler heads, including Carl Tamayo, who plays for the Sakers, intervened.
